title: Physical Chemistry Iii
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the enthalpy change accompanying a reaction in which a molecule is shattered into its component atoms."
Enthalpy of atomization is the enthalpy change accompanying a reaction in which a molecule is shattered into its component atoms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the product of the force applied (F) and the distance (X)moved along the direction of the force."
Work (W) is defined as the product of the force applied (F) and the distance (X)moved along the direction of the force.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the heat required to raise the temperature of a body by 1 K."
Heat capacity is the heat required to raise the temperature of a body by 1 K.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a state function whose change in a constant- pressure process is equal to the amount of heat transferred to the system in the process."
The enthalpy is a state function whose change in a constant- pressure process is equal to the amount of heat transferred to the system in the process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a thermodynamic property of a system, whereas work and heat are not."
Energy is a thermodynamic property of a system, whereas work and heat are not.
fib: ______ is a measure of the molar Gibbs energy of a real gas.
The fugacity is a measure of the molar Gibbs energy of a real gas.
______ is an important concept in the branch of physics known as thermodynamics.
Entropy is an important concept in the branch of physics known as thermodynamics.
______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is a useful concept in thermochemistry.
Bond enthalpy is a useful concept in thermochemistry.
